newMethods.name: testFreshArchiveAndExactReuseKeepOnePrivateVerifiedFile
newMethods.sourceControls: Fresh exact archive and subsequent reuse preserve inode, 0400/private-owner/nlink1 and bytes; one output entry; prospective normal journal root/scope can be admitted without claiming journal execution.

newMethods.name: testCaptureAndUnlistedDescendantAreRefusedAsEitherOutputParent
newMethods.sourceControls: Capture root and an unlisted private descendant are refused as journal or payload parents; an explicit symlink alias is refused; sentinel bytes and unused output directories remain unchanged.

newMethods.name: testPartialOrWritableExistingArchiveIsRetainedAndNeverOverwritten
newMethods.sourceControls: A short 0400 file and exact 0600 bytes are refused, with original bytes/inode/mode/name retained.

newMethods.name: testReplacedOutputOrExistingJournalScopeRefusesBeforeMaterialization
newMethods.sourceControls: Replacing the admitted payload directory or existing exact journal scope causes validate/materialize refusal before archive output; retained old directory stays empty.
